summary: Retest of /admin/staking Wallets CMS tab after iteration_39 CRITICAL fix (missing <td> for 'Acciones' + wallets pager). All required flows now pass. The per-row 'Nueva solicitud' button is rendered on every row, prefill flow works end-to-end (no submit executed, per constraints), and the wallets pager behaves correctly. Stakings pager regression check also passes.
verified_flows: Wallets tab renders 10 rows on page 1 with 10 staking-wallet-cashin-btn-{i} buttons (1:1 with rows). Column 'Acciones' populated in tbody.

Search 'qa-cuenta' → filters to 1 row (qa-cuenta-nueva@prosper.foundation). Click on that row's cashin button → tab switches to 'Nueva solicitud' and staking-cashin-prosperid input value = 'qa-cuenta-nueva@prosper.foundation'. Submit intentionally NOT triggered (side-effects on CMS mainnet forbidden).
staking-wallets-pager visible with 15 wallets: 'Anterior' disabled on page 1 ('1–10 de 15'); click 'Siguiente' → page 2 shows '11–15 de 15' (5 rows).
Search 'qa-cuenta' resets to page 1 and hides the pager (1 result ≤ PAGE_SIZE).
Regression: staking-pager (Stakings tab) still visible with '1–10 de 13' → 2 pages.
minor_observations: After clicking a row's cashin button (which sets cashinPrefill), navigating back to Wallets tab and then manually clicking staking-tab-btn-cashin keeps the previously-set prefill in the input. This is likely by-design state persistence, but the review spec 'sin venir de una fila → input vacío' is only strictly true on first manual open. Not blocking. If desired, clear cashinPrefill when the user clicks the wallets tab or manually clicks the cashin tab.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix verified in frontend/src/app/admin/staking/page.tsx lines 457-466: <td> with data-testid staking-wallet-cashin-btn-{i}, disabled when !(email||prosperId||userId). Pager rendered at line 474-476 with correct guard items.length > 0.
onRequestCashin uses r.email || r.prosperId || r.userId — matches the enable condition, so no orphaned clicks.
seed_data_creation: none — used existing 15 wallets in CMS; no create/submit performed
context_for_next_testing_agent: iteration_39 CRITICAL bug (missing <td> for Acciones + missing wallets pager) is fully fixed. All wallets-tab flows and stakings pager regression pass. Only minor UX nit: manual reopen of cashin tab retains prior prefill (state not cleared).
